company.name: Anxiety Checklist
company.shortDescription: Anxiety Checklist is a mental health mobile app offering CBT tools, grounding exercises, guided audio, and expert led masterclass videos.
company.description:
Anxiety Checklist is a mental health technology company focused on practical tools for managing anxiety and panic. The company develops a mobile app that combines evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) tools, structured journaling, grounding exercises, guided audio, and expert-led educational content.

The platform is designed to support users both during acute anxiety or panic episodes and in daily self-regulation practice. Core features include CBT journaling to help users identify and reframe unhelpful thought patterns, real-time grounding tools for panic symptoms, guided affirmations and hypnosis-based audio sessions, and on-demand masterclass videos led by experienced anxiety and panic specialists.

Anxiety Checklist differentiates itself by focusing on moment-of-need support and practical application rather than passive meditation or motivational content. The tools are designed to work together as an integrated system, helping users reduce fear responses, build long-term resilience, and regain a sense of control over anxiety symptoms.

The company serves individuals experiencing anxiety disorders, panic attacks, and chronic stress, particularly those seeking structured, self-guided support outside of traditional therapy settings.
